title: Audition extracted PCM instruments in sequences
changes: Resolve sequence program and key selections through the extracted tone banks and key maps, and use linked PCM samples and stored loop flags where available.
Show each note’s program and mapped wave; unsupported or unavailable voices fall back to sine waves, and the user can select sine-only playback.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-pcmvoice-51yozacf checked direct and split mappings, PCM buffer values, approximate pitch, loop flags, fallback and sine-only mode; legacy unit emswkwfc checked datasets without instrument metadata.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-pcmvoice-eur-07frb244 compared four banks, 429 tones, 348 key links and 455 headers, checked mapped notes against the source and exercised PCM Web Audio start/stop in Chrome.
limitations: Pitch uses the existing BIOS HLE approximation and is limited to 384000 Hz. Timing is user-selected; envelopes, note extensions, pitch changes, effects and unsupported channels are not reproduced. Physical audio and original-driver fidelity remain unverified.
